name: @utir/ssc
description: Deploy and manage apps on Utir

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --external:commander --external:axios --external:archiver --external:form-data --external:ignore --alias:@ssc/client=../client/src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js
